## Circular to Licensed Corporations

## Implementation of Hong Kong Accounting Standards 39 and 32

On 2 June 2004, the Hong Kong Society of Accountants (HKSA) issued a press release about the proposed  implementation  of  two  Hong  Kong  Accounting  Standards  (HKAS),  HKAS  39 Financial  Instruments:  Recognition  and  Measurement and  HKAS  32 Financial  Instruments: Disclosure  and  Presentation .  These  two  standards  are  based  on  the  international  accounting standards  issued  by  the  International  Accounting  Standards  Board.  They  are  to  be  applied prospectively  for  accounting  periods  beginning  on  or  after  1  January  2005  with  earlier application  prohibited.  The  press  release  and  the  two  standards  are  available  on  the  HKSA website at http://www.hksa.org.hk/professionaltechnical/accounting/pressrelease and http://www.hksa.org.hk/professionaltechnical/accounting/standards respectively.

These new standards may affect your financial position and consequently your ability to comply with the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules (SFFRR).  As a result, you are urged to assess the implications of these accounting standards (including seeking appropriate professional  advice)  and  start  to  make  any  necessary  arrangements  for  their  impending implementation.

You  are  also  welcomed  to  discuss  with  the  responsible  case  officer  of  the  Intermediaries Supervision  Department  if  you  foresee  any  problems  in  relation  to  the  compliance  with  the SFFRR as a result of the implementation of these accounting standards.

Should you have any queries regarding the above, please contact Ms Madonna Yip at 2842-7618.
